Why it matters

Most recipe extractors solve the wrong problem (they scrape everything). This one does the cheap thing first — schema.org — and only pays for an LLM when the page refuses. The architecture is the point.

The trick

Two-tier extractor: schema.org JSON-LD first (free, exact), Claude as a typed fallback. Source attribution stored on every recipe.

Browser-paste escape hatch (--html-file) for sites that ja3-fingerprint node-fetch. Ugly, pragmatic, works.

One Pot Chicken and Rice

v 1.4.2 DEPLOYED · last sync 12 min ago

One Pot Chicken and Rice

via schema.org · extracted by schema

Ingredients
4 – 6 Tbspbutter (divided)
1 heaping cupshredded carrots
2 scant cupslong grain white rice
1 Tbspdried minced onion
1 tspdried minced garlic
2 Tbspdried parsley flakes
8 cupschicken stock
2chicken breasts (~1 lb, bite-sized)
Method
1

Melt 2 Tablespoons butter in a large soup pot. Add carrots, season with salt and pepper, cover, cook until tender (5–6 min).

2

Add rice, dried onions, garlic. Stir to coat. Saute 1 minute. Add parsley + chicken stock. Bring to a boil.

3

Reduce heat. Simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add seasoned chicken. Simmer 7–10 more minutes.

4

Stir in remaining butter. Season. Rest 5 minutes. Serve.
